target.title: fix(cron): channel failure alerts drop when global webhook failure destination is set
target.body:
Closes #102235

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators who set a job-level channel failure destination (for example `--failure-channel slack --failure-to #alerts` without `--failure-mode`) would never receive cron failure alerts when `cron.failureDestination` defaulted to a global webhook. The chat target was treated as a webhook URL, failed validation, and the failure notification was dropped with only a "webhook URL is invalid, skipping" log.

## Why This Change Was Made

`resolveFailureDestination` only reconciled `mode` when the job object included a `mode` field. A channel-shaped job override without `mode` therefore kept the inherited global webhook mode. This change treats a channel-shaped job failure destination without `mode` as announce (matching primary delivery defaults), clears an inherited webhook URL when mode switches, and leaves to-only overrides free to inherit a global webhook mode.

Gateway dispatcher coverage was added so the finished-error notification path proves announce dispatch and does not emit the invalid-webhook skip for this shape.

## User Impact

Cron failure alerts configured as channel/announce routes keep working even when a global webhook failure destination is also configured. Operators no longer lose job-level Slack/Telegram/etc. failure routes just because they omitted `--failure-mode`.

## Evidence

Resolver + gateway dispatcher regressions for #102235:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/delivery.test.ts src/gateway/server-cron-notifications.test.ts
 ✓ |cron| src/cron/delivery.test.ts (22 tests)
 ✓ |gateway-server| src/gateway/server-cron-notifications.test.ts (5 tests)
 ✓ |gateway-methods| src/gateway/server-cron-notifications.test.ts (5 tests)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-cron-notifications.test.ts -t "#102235"
 ✓ announces channel-shaped failure destinations without mode under a global webhook default (#102235)
 Tests  1 passed | 4 skipped
```

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Job-level channel-shaped failure destinations without `mode` must not inherit a global webhook mode and silently drop channel failure alerts at the gateway finished-notification path.
- Environment: macOS local checkout; Node via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`; branch `grok/cron-failure-dest-channel-mode` at `ac1e51471625eb9c626f69e0f15991d986035d52`.
- Current-main contrast:
  - Inputs: global `cron.failureDestination = { mode: "webhook", to: "https://hook.example/cron" }`; job `failureDestination = { channel: "slack", to: "#alerts" }` (no mode); `evt.status = "error"`.
  - Main resolves `mode: "webhook", to: "#alerts"`, then gateway logs `cron: failure destination webhook URL is invalid, skipping` and drops the alert (no announce, no webhook POST).
  - This branch resolves `mode: "announce", channel: "slack", to: "#alerts"` and calls `sendFailureNotificationAnnounce` for Slack `#alerts`.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-cron-notifications.test.ts -t "#102235"`
  2. That test calls real `dispatchGatewayCronFinishedNotifications` with the reported config shape and a mocked announce/webhook transport.
- Evidence after fix (gateway dispatcher transcript):
  ```text
  dispatchGatewayCronFinishedNotifications({
    evt: { status: "error", error: "boom", jobId: "cron-channel-fd-no-mode" },
    job.delivery.failureDestination: { channel: "slack", to: "#alerts" }, // no mode
    globalFailureDestination: { mode: "webhook", to: "https://hook.example/cron" },
  })

  Observed:
  - sendFailureNotificationAnnounce called once
  - target: { channel: "slack", to: "#alerts", inheritSessionThread: false }
  - message: '⚠️ Cron job "channel fd no mode" failed: boom'
  - logger.warn NOT called with "cron: failure destination webhook URL is invalid, skipping"
  - fetchWithSsrFGuard NOT called (no webhook POST of #alerts)

  Vitest:
  ✓ announces channel-shaped failure destinations without mode under a global webhook default (#102235)
  Tests  1 passed | 4 skipped
  ```
- Control check:
  - Resolver still inherits global webhook for a to-only override without channel/mode (`to: "https://other.example/hook"` stays webhook).
  - Explicit-mode announce/webhook job overrides remain covered by existing `resolveFailureDestination` tests.
- Observed result after fix: channel-shaped job destinations without mode resolve and dispatch as announce to the job channel/target; global webhook defaults no longer poison those routes into the invalid-URL skip path.
- What was not tested: live Slack/Telegram tenant delivery end-to-end (transport is mocked at the gateway notification boundary); full remote `pnpm check:changed` Crabbox/Testbox in the contributor environment.

## AI disclosure

This fix was implemented with AI assistance (Grok). The behavior change and tests were verified locally against the reported resolver and gateway finished-notification path; please review the inheritance edge cases and compatibility semantics before merge.
